A 3×3×3 pump house that stands in water and pumps it with FE: enough for a full-size Steam Boiler Array.
# Placing it
- Its intake is the middle of its bottom face: the block under it must be a water source.
- That water must be part of a body of at least 400 connected water sources (counted through water sources only). A lake, a river or the sea will do; a pond won't.
- It doesn't use the water up.
# Pumping
- 8,000 mB/t, ×1.25 in rivers and oceans.
- 0.25 FE per mB: 2,000 FE/t.
- Its Output ports push the water out on their own, as fast as it pumps; Fluid Conduits can pull it too.
